//===== pre-renewal-spawns ====================================================
//= Swaps the renewal spawns for pre-renewal ones on the maps both eras have.
//= Generated by registry/tools/pre-renewal-spawns/build_spawns.py from rAthena
//= 5209ce07ec58dc7f1875da47d8e6b0e0bae2a9a1. Do not edit by hand; rerun the script.
//=================================================================

-	script	pre_renewal_spawns	-1,{
	end;

OnInit:
	// Once every OnInit has run. A file unloaded during that pass would
	// leave it to chance whether its scripts' OnInit had run yet.
	sleep 1;

	// These files spawn on pre-renewal maps. What they spawn on maps
	// pre-renewal never had is in this mod's npc/re/, already loaded.
	// Their scripts loaded after this mod's copies, under new names, and
	// go with them.
	atcommand "@unloadnpcfile npc/re/mobs/championmobs.txt";
	atcommand "@unloadnpcfile npc/re/mobs/dungeons/abbey.txt";
	atcommand "@unloadnpcfile npc/re/mobs/dungeons/abyss.txt";
	atcommand "@unloadnpcfile npc/re/mobs/dungeons/alde_dun.txt";
	atcommand "@unloadnpcfile npc/re/mobs/dungeons/ama_dun.txt";

	// An unloaded script's summoned monsters stay behind...
	killmonster "com_d02_i","All";
	killmonster "lhz_dun03","All";
	killmonster "lhz_dun04","All";
	killmonster "niflheim","All";
	// ...so the scripts that summon on those maps start over.
	donpcevent "NifInvasion::OnInit";
	donpcevent "illusion_luanda::OnInit";
	donpcevent "mvp_lhz_dun04::OnInit";
	donpcevent "summon_boss_lt::OnInit";

	debugmes "pre-renewal-spawns: replaced 62 renewal spawn files";
	end;
}
